CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-roster-sync, at head b96aab8b85f167f25ac72ba840ef10095f655229. Bus nonce: fecb4eb2c79559ebe08851870581b36c. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch b96aab8b85f167f25ac72ba840ef10095f655229 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-roster-sync, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-roster-sync <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-roster-sync; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer round 2, topic r10-roster-sync (PR #2554, branch fix/r10-roster-sync, PR head b96aab8b85f167f25ac72ba840ef10095f655229; previous code ref refs/heads/handoff/r10-roster-sync, body ref refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-roster-sync). Group R10-ROSTER-OPS (roster-sync deliverable). Fix review blocked. Read the full verdict: git fetch origin probe/rev-2554-2c937958 && git show origin/probe/rev-2554-2c937958:verdict.md (evidence under ev/ on the same ref; git show origin/probe/rev-2554-2c937958:ev/<file>). Five blocking items. The reviewer reproduced the body's roster_sync (34/0), roster_edit (64/0), state_docs, base harness and mutation table M1-M6 exactly: keep them, re-take what you touch.

1. `closures` is red (check run 119202770035, SCOPE_CASE full): INERT READS UNDER-APPROXIMATED for tests/entities.py: tools/audit/carry_audit.py, tools/audit/seat/roster_edit.py, tools/audit/seat/roster_sync.py; closures-autofix reported skip-merge-failed, so no bot commit is coming. Cause: state_docs.py (moved out of the INERT tools/audit/ prefix by tests/closure.py's exception list because entities.py loads it) now imports roster_sync, and through it roster_edit and carry_audit. Fix: add the three beside ref_privacy.py in tests/closure.py's exception list (precedent closure.py:765, #2310), and show with the reviewer's plant (ev/underscope-plant.txt: a one-line plant in roster_sync.py made `tests/closure.py select --diff HEAD` print `MODE: SCOPED -- 0 script(s) run`) that after the fix a roster_sync.py plant selects entities.py. Name closures in ## Red checks and answer it (item 8fac8b5b). Closure-file edits land under CI, so PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 stays.
2. `pr-contract` BAD-DEST on items b79e7e68 and 00bf85b5 (R10-ORCH-MACHINERY not a group of the head's tree roster): merging current origin/main clears it; re-run carry_audit with --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster to confirm 0 bad destinations (item c0223ec1).
3. Forward-carry not on the roster (item 4ddebe42): the two ## Forward-carry findings (ci_predict.py does not run the layout guard, to R10-ORCH-MACHINERY; ref_privacy --check ignores \b on a macOS seat, to R10-POLICY-GATE-SCOPING) are not in either group's roster carry at 23ef06dc6. DO NOT edit the roster yourself: the orchestrator lands both carries before review and the dispatch will give you the roster SHA. State each carry's control as a precondition in the body and name the roster SHA once visible at origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (re-fetch; if still absent say so and push anyway).
4. Design trace not disposed (item b1ecb708, harness: design-trace-missing): R10-ROSTER-OPS roster carry[3] and the approved design (handoff/orch-machinery 09174d94, DESIGN.md section 6.4) assign three predicates to the roster-sync step ("this group is their one owner"): (1) gate coverage, class times mandate scope; (2) absorbed-edge closure, ABSORB-EDGE-MISSING; (3) commit resolution by prefix with `git rev-parse --disambiguate`, RECORD-INVALID. carry[4] (from #2545) adds a brief pinned at handoff and compared on a later pass. roster_sync.py implements none of the four. R10-ROSTER-OPS is done at 929275e8, so after merge nothing owns them. Build each here, or give each an explicit disposition with a LIVE destination (a live roster group such as R10-ORCH-MACHINERY or an open issue; never R10-ROSTER-OPS, it is done). If you disposition rather than build any, say so per predicate in the body and SendMessage nothing: the orchestrator lands the destination carry on request, so list (group, carry text) of each in the body.
5. Sibling topics decide each other's stage (item bf644354): matches() applies B13's `name.startswith(topic + "-")` arm and derive() lets one PR decide every group whose topic is a prefix of its head. Reviewer probe (ev/sibling-probe.txt): merged fix/r10-stale-paths-2 moved both R10-STALE-PATHS and R10-STALE-PATHS-2 to done; open fix/r10-deeplink-census moved the DONE R10-DEEPLINK back to in-progress. The live roster has 3 such prefix pairs (DEEPLINK/DEEPLINK-CENSUS, DEEPLINK/DEEPLINK-HANDLERS, STALE-PATHS/STALE-PATHS-2; ev/topic-collisions.txt). Fix: prefer the longest matching topic, or exclude a head that another group matches more specifically; add a sibling-pair fixture arm and a mutant that fails it.
6. (same round) Unpinned behaviour: R2 (exact-match-only), R9 (-pr suffix not stripped), R6 (carry dedupe dropped), R8 (issue destination not appended) survive (ev/reviewer-mutants.txt); R5 is equivalent. Add fixtures that pin R2, R9, R6 and R8 each alone (a positive fixture matching only through the `<topic>-` arm and only through the `-pr` strip; a repeated carry; an issue-destination arm), and fail them under the mutants; also pin the rc-path `_reset`. Fix the roster_sync.py docstring: it still carries the withdrawn "2 of the live roster's 48 merged groups; this one finds 47" count, and cites the design as dev/audit/machinery while it is dev/audit/design/orch-machinery/DESIGN.md on handoff/orch-machinery (item 5ed82be8). nightly-status is main's: carry it to R10-REPLAY-CAP (item 57bf9e90) as the reviewer did.
 Then, always: merge current origin/main (never rebase) and PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; re-measure every figure your change touches at your new head; answer every red check at your head in ## Red checks (nightly-status grades main); follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md; standing rule 19 on every observation (Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | dismissed: <reason 2+ words>, then (item <id>)), verified with python3 tools/audit/seat/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body <body.md>. Keep evidence you push small (no multi-hundred-KB outputs). Push code to handoff/r10-roster-sync and the body with bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-roster-sync <body.md>; the handoff-body push is your return signal.
